answer_1.quote: This study tackles the challenges of enhancing the COMET metric for various under-resourced African languages. ... and establish benchmark MT evaluation (AFRICOMET) and reference-free QE (AFRICOMET-QE) systems.

answer_2.quote: We benchmark our models against (1) the widely used ngram matching based evaluation metrics Sacre-BLEU and chrf++, (2) the embedding-based metric, BERTScore, (3) LLM Prompting based GPT-4 output with OpenAI API and (4) the learned COMET22 metric ...

answer_3.quote: We benchmark our models against ... (3) LLM Prompting based GPT-4 output with OpenAI API ...

answer_4.quote: We implement a stringent evaluation protocol for each translation, involving a minimum of two bilingual native speakers as evaluators ...
answer_4.guideline: we propose a simplified MQM guideline focusing on translation adequacy, combining translation accuracy error detection with DA scoring for ease of use by non-expert evaluators. Similarly, we create a distinct MQM guideline for translation fluency, combining translation fluency error detection with DA scoring.
